title: HR Executive - Manufacturing
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **HR Executive** 
 to manage end\-to\-end HR operations and administration for the organization. The role will be responsible for talent acquisition, manpower planning, employee engagement, performance management, statutory compliance, employee relations and HR administration.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Manpower Planning**
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for plant and corporate positions.
* Develop manpower plans based on business and operational requirements.
* Manage onboarding, induction, employee documentation and exits.
* Partner with business heads to identify current and future manpower requirements.


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations and employee lifecycle processes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Manage PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Factory Act and other statutory compliances.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR MIS and personnel documentation.
* Coordinate statutory audits, inspections and compliance activities.


**Employee Relations \& Engagement**
* Handle employee queries, grievances and disciplinary matters.
* Maintain positive employee relations and workplace culture.
* Drive employee engagement, welfare and retention initiatives.
* Support industrial relations and shop\-floor employee matters.


**Performance Management \& Training**
* Coordinate performance appraisal and review processes.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Coordinate employee training, learning and development initiatives.
* Monitor training effectiveness and employee development.


**Payroll \& HR Administration**
* Coordinate payroll inputs, attendance, leave and employee master data.
* Work closely with Finance/payroll vendors to ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
* Manage HR policies, procedures and employee communication.
* Oversee general administration, facilities and vendor coordination as required.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree with MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* 2\+ years of experience in HR Generalist / HR Operations roles.
* Experience in manufacturing / engineering / industrial environment preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management and HR operations.
* Good knowledge of PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Factory Act and POSH.
* Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Good proficiency in MS Office and HRMS.

**Job Summary:**
 As an Individual Contributor – People Capability Business Partner, you will play a key role in
 **supporting and executing the people agenda in close partnership with the Senior Manager PCBP** 
 and business stakeholders.
   

  

 The role requires strong execution capability, sound PC judgment, and the ability to independently manage day\-to\-day and moderately complex people matters across the employee lifecycle. You will work closely with the PC team and business Leaders to
 **drive consistency in PC practices, support key initiatives, and enhance overall employee experience** 
 , while being guided on broader priorities and direction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Business Partnership \& PC Delivery
* Work closely with the Senior PCBP to support delivery of key People Capability priorities and initiatives
* Partner with business managers to address day\-to\-day people matters, ensuring timely and consistent support
* Support execution of PC programs across PC operations, L\&D, communications, and change initiatives
* Act as a reliable point of contact for managers for operational and employee\-related queries
* Demonstrate strong business acumen by understanding organizational goals, translating them into people strategies, and delivering measurable impact.
* Act as a proactive and trusted partner to leaders by anticipating the BU/emp needs, influencing decisions, and driving forward\-looking HR initiatives.
* Translate AI\-driven insights into actionable people strategies, partnering with business leaders to identify risks, opportunities, and future talent needs.
* Champion responsible and ethical use of AI in HR, ensuring compliance, data privacy, and fairness in decision\-making processes.
* Continuously explore emerging AI capabilities to innovate HR practices and deliver scalable, forward\-looking solutions aligned with organizational priorities.
* Talent Management \& Development
* Support execution of performance management, talent reviews, and development planning cycles
* Guide managers on performance conversations, goal setting, and development actions
* Help identify talent gaps and coordinate with relevant teams on hiring or development interventions
* Track and follow up on key talent actions to ensure closure

* Manage and resolve employee relations queries and moderately complex cases, with guidance as needed
* Partner with Senior Manager PCBP, PC Ops, and legal teams on sensitive or high\-impact cases
* Ensure consistent application of PC policies and adherence to compliance requirements
* Maintain documentation and ensure timely closure of cases
* Change \& Communication Support
* Support implementation of change initiatives, including org updates, transitions, and policy rollouts
* Work with managers to ensure clear communication and smooth adoption of changes
* Reinforce key messages and ensure alignment across teams
* Compensation \& Rewards Support
* Support compensation processes including salary reviews, promotions, and benchmarking inputs
* Assist in validating data and ensuring internal parity and consistency
* Partner with COEs and Senior PCBP on compensation\-related queries and cases
* Employee Experience \& Engagement
* Support execution of engagement initiatives such as surveys, focus groups, and team interventions
* Gather and share insights on employee sentiment with the Senior PCBP
* Track action plans and follow up with managers to ensure progress
* Assist in driving initiatives that enhance team morale and employee experience
* PC Operations \& Governance
* Ensure smooth execution of key PC processes including onboarding, transfers, mobility, and exits
* Collaborate with PC COEs (TA, L\&D, Rewards, Ops) to deliver aligned solutions
* Ensure compliance with policies, processes, and employment guidelines

* Good understanding of PC processes across ER, performance, and talent management
* Ability to partner effectively with managers and collaborate within PC teams
* Strong problem\-solving skills with attention to detail

* Good communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks effectively


**Education \& Experience**
* 4\-8 years of experience into PCBP responsibilities
* Experience supporting business teams in operational PC and employee relations
* Exposure to multiple PC areas (performance, ER, engagement, basic comp)

* Design and implement change strategies for large\-scale initiatives, ensuring organizational readiness and capacity for adoption.
* Analyze data and translate insights into actionable plans; communicate findings effectively to secure leadership buy\-in.
* Balance tactical execution and strategic HR priorities in support of business needs.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and health \& safety standards.
* Conduct internal investigations with discretion and professionalism; recommend appropriate actions and resolutions.
* Navigate a complex, matrixed global environment and ensure compliance with local country regulations and policies.


**Candidate Profile**
 The candidate is proactive, result\-oriented, and able to:
   

  

* Collaborate effectively across teams, functions, and business units.
* Influence stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and act as a constructive change agent.
* Apply systems thinking and organizational effectiveness tools to diagnose and design solutions.
* Support large, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver against deadlines.
* Translate strategy into clear goals, action plans, and measurable outcomes; track and communicate progress at all levels.
* Develop compelling, data\-driven business cases that drive leadership decisions.
* Operate effectively in a fast\-paced, global environment.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Design and implement HR policies and procedures to ensure compliance and engagement.
* Synthesize complex information into clear, audience\-appropriate communications and visuals.

title: Global People Relations Partner
description:
**Global Lead – Employee Relations:\-**
 Sapiens is looking for a Global Lead – Employee Relations to lead our Global Employee Relations function, based in Bangalore. If you're a seasoned ER professional ready to take your career to the next level with an established, globally successful company, this role could be the right fit for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do:\-**
 The Global Lead – Employee Relations role is a critical position within Sapiens' People Success function, responsible for maintaining a positive and productive work environment and ensuring regulatory compliance reporting to the VP, Global People Success – Regions. The successful candidate will manage and enhance Employee Relations strategies, handle complex employee issues, and develop policies and processes that contribute to our DNA of “Advance the Possible”. This role designs and governs global ER frameworks centrally, partners with local People Success Partners for regional implementation, and acts as a strategic advisor across all geographies.
   

  

* Employee Relations Strategy: Develop and implement strategies to address and resolve employee relations issues, promote a positive workplace culture, and enhance employee engagement and retention.
* Conflict Resolution: Act as a mediator and advisor for complex employee relations issues and disputes, providing guidance and resolution in line with company policies and legal requirements.
* Policy Development: Create, review, and update employee relations policies and procedures to ensure compliance with current employment laws and best practices.
* Data Analysis: Monitor and analyze employee relations metrics and trends, using AI\-powered analytics and reporting tools to identify patterns, predict risk areas, and prepare recommendations for senior management to drive continuous improvement.
* Compliance and Legal: Ensure the company's practices adhere to state and local employment laws and regulations. Partner with legal counsel when necessary to address compliance issues.
* Communication: Foster open lines of communication between employees and management; counsel managers and employees on ER\-related matters; facilitate effective dialogue to address concerns and promote a transparent work environment.
* Training: Develop and deliver training programs for managers and employees on employee relations topics, including conflict resolution, performance management, and harassment prevention — leveraging AI tools to build, personalize, and scale training content.
* Case Management: Oversee the investigation and resolution of employee complaints and grievances, using AI\-enabled case management tools to ensure a fair, thorough, and efficient process.
* Global ER Ownership: Design and own the global ER framework and operating model, establishing Sapiens' India\-based ER function for all geographies. Define global ER policies and practices centrally, enabling local teams to manage regional implementation with appropriate nuance.
* People Success Partnership: Collaborate with country People Success Leaders and local People Success Partners to implement ER frameworks regionally, acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert across all geographies, including India, APAC, and globally.
* Shared Services Integration: Partner closely with case managers within the Shared Services team to ensure seamless end\-to\-end ER case management, driving consistency and quality in case resolution outcomes globally.
* AI\-Driven Efficiency: Actively identify and implement opportunities to use AI and automation tools across ER processes — case triage, policy drafting, sentiment/trend analysis, and reporting — to improve speed, consistency, and decision quality.
* Recruitment \& Compliance Support: Participate in recruitment and dismissal processes and govern employee background checks.


**What To Have For This Position**
**Must\-Have Skills:\-**
* Experience required: 10–15 years
* At least 7\+ years of experience in employee relations roles in global companies
* MA in Organizational Psychology, Behavioural Science, or a related field, or MBA/HR
* In\-depth knowledge and experience of employment laws globally, with expertise across India, Europe and North America
* Mandatory — AI Tool Proficiency: Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., generative AI, AI\-assisted analytics, and case/workflow automation platforms), and comfort using AI to support case management, policy drafting, data analysis, and reporting
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong problem\-solving ability
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion
* Cultural sensitivity and empathy
* Ability to build trust and rapport with employees at all levels of the organization


**About Sapiens:\-**
 Sapiens International Corporation is a global leader in intelligent insurance software solutions. With Sapiens' robust platform, customer\-driven partnerships, and rich ecosystem, insurers are empowered to future\-proof their organizations with operational excellence in a rapidly changing marketplace. We help insurers harness the power of AI and advanced automation to support core solutions for property and casualty, workers' compensation, and life insurance, including reinsurance, financial \& compliance, data \& analytics, digital, and decision management. Sapiens has a longtime global presence, serving over 600 customers in more than 30 countries with its innovative SaaS offerings. Recognized by industry experts and selected for the Microsoft Top 100 Partner program, Sapiens is committed to partnering with our customers for their entire transformation journey and is continuously innovating to ensure their success. For more information, visit www.sapiens.com.
   

  

 Sapiens is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment that embraces individuals from diverse backgrounds.

title: Regional People Operations Specialist
description:
**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Challenge**
 The Regional People Operations Specialist (P3\) is a key contributor within the Tier 2 People Operations function, responsible for driving the effective resolution of complex, regionally nuanced People matters. This role acts as a critical bridge between Tier 1 service delivery and strategic People partners, ensuring seamless execution of employee lifecycle processes with a strong emphasis on compliance, consistency, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Operating as a trusted partner to HRBPs, Country Partners, Legal, and cross\-functional stakeholders, this role supports performance management, employee relations, and regional operations while identifying opportunities to enhance scalability, efficiency, and overall service delivery. Additionally, this role contributes to Talent Acquisition operations, supporting a cohesive and high\-quality experience across the candidate\-to\-employee lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Escalation Management \& Regional Operations**
* Serve as a Tier 2 escalation point for complex and sensitive People Operations matters, ensuring timely, compliant, and high\-quality resolution
* Manage regionally specific employee lifecycle processes, applying appropriate local context while maintaining global standards
* Partner cross\-functionally to ensure alignment and effective execution of People initiatives


**Performance Management \& Risk Mitigation**
* Support the operational execution of performance management and employee relations processes, including performance improvement actions and organizational changes
* Partner with HRBPs, Legal, and regional stakeholders to mitigate risk and ensure adherence to local labor laws and company policies
* Maintain rigor in documentation, timelines, and execution standards


**HRBP \& Regional Partner Enablement**
* Act as an operational advisor to HRBPs and Country Partners, providing guidance on processes, policies, and regional requirements
* Enable seamless collaboration across People functions to drive consistent and effective employee outcomes


**Talent Acquisition Operations Support**
* Contribute to the effectiveness of Talent Acquisition operations by supporting recruiting processes, systems, and data integrity
* Partner with recruiting teams to ensure efficient workflows and a seamless transition from candidate to employee


**Process Optimization \& Operational Excellence**
* Identify trends, inefficiencies, and operational gaps impacting service delivery
* Contribute to process improvements, automation initiatives, and scalable solutions in partnership with Global People Operations, HRIS, and IT
* Support continuous improvement of workflows, tools, and service models


**Operational Governance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure alignment of regional operations with global standards and compliance requirements
* Contribute to documentation, standardization, and evolution of Tier 2 operating procedures
* Provide insights on trends, risks, and opportunities to enhance People Operations effectiveness


**Your Experience Includes**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in management, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in HR Operations / Talent Acquisition Operations Support


 Where we Work
   

  

 We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
   

  

 Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
   

  

 Resources
   

  

 Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
   

  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram


 Your Data
   

  

 You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
 **.** 
 You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
   

  

 Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
   

  

**Our Commitment to You**
 When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

title: Director Human Resources
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 We are hiring for People Operations \& Talent to build and lead the People function for a new Bangalore business unit, establishing the organization's presence, workforce, culture, and people infrastructure in India as the business grows.
 



  





 This leader will develop the people strategy and operating foundation for the Bangalore launch, including workforce planning, talent acquisition, organizational design, policies, employee experience, and HR operations. The role will transition into on\-site leadership as the office opens, serving as a visible executive presence and building and leading an on\-site HR team.
 



  





 The director will partner closely with U.S.\-based executives, the global People team, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Technology functions to support a multidisciplinary workforce spanning software engineering, infrastructure, QA, data engineering, analytics, and shared services.
 



 The ideal candidate will bring deep knowledge of the Indian talent market and employment environment, experience supporting a U.S.\-based technology organization, and a strong track record of building and scaling People functions in high\-growth environments. Experience in healthcare technology or another regulated, data\-intensive industry is strongly preferred.
 



  





**What You Will Own :** 




  





 1\. People Strategy \& Business Leadership
 


* Develop and execute the India People strategy, aligning local priorities with global business objectives and serving as a strategic advisor to U.S. executives and India business leaders.
* Lead workforce planning, organizational design, talent strategy, culture, employee relations, and people\-related business decisions.
* Establish the People operating framework for the Bangalore business unit, ensuring scalable processes and infrastructure from launch through growth.
* Act as a visible executive and culture carrier, translating global priorities into effective local practices.
* Build trusted relationships across India and U.S. teams, ensuring the India organization operates as an integrated part of the global business.



  





 2\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Growth
 


* Build and lead a scalable talent acquisition strategy for Bangalore, from initial setup through sustained workforce growth.
* Partner with functional leaders to develop workforce plans, hiring roadmaps, and talent strategies across engineering, infrastructure, QA, data, analytics, and shared services.
* Establish effective sourcing, selection, and employer\-branding strategies to attract high\-quality technical and business talent in the competitive Bangalore market.
* Build and lead a high\-performing Talent Acquisition function, including hiring and developing the People Operations team.
* Develop recruiting partnerships, university relationships, and talent pipelines to support current and future workforce requirements.
* Establish data\-driven recruiting practices and metrics, including time to fill, quality of hire, offer acceptance, cost of hiring, and retention.
* Collaborate with business leaders to forecast talent requirements and proactively address workforce capacity and hiring risks.



  





 3\. Culture, Employee Engagement \& Organizational Effectiveness
 


* Establish and reinforce the organization's culture, values, and employee experience across the Bangalore workforce.
* Develop initiatives that connect the India team with the organization's mission, global leadership, and international teams.
* Design and implement employee engagement and retention strategies based on workforce data and employee feedback.
* Establish listening mechanisms, including employee surveys, focus groups, and leadership forums, to identify concerns and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with business leaders on organizational structure, onboarding, performance management, talent reviews, succession planning, and internal mobility.
* Analyze engagement, attrition, and workforce trends to provide actionable insights to leadership on organizational health, capacity, and retention risks.



  





 4\. People Operations, HR Governance \& Compliance
 


* Build and establish the People Operations infrastructure required to support the India business from launch through scale.
* Develop an India employee handbook, HR policies, and operating procedures aligned with global standards and applicable Indian employment requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate governance across hiring, employee records, compensation, performance management, leave, benefits, and separation.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex employee matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and well\-documented processes for employee concerns and investigations.
* Identify and proactively manage workforce risks, partnering with internal stakeholders and external advisors where required.
* Oversee coordination with external service providers supporting payroll, benefits administration, background verification, and other HR services.
* Ensure HR operations and employee lifecycle processes are scalable, compliant, and aligned with business requirements.



  





 5\. People Team Leadership \& Cross\-Border Collaboration
 


* Build, lead, and develop an India People team of approximately 3–5 employees across Talent Acquisition, People Operations, HR Business Partnership, and Employee Experience.
* Establish clear roles, goals, performance expectations, and accountability across the People function.
* Coach and develop team members, building a strong pipeline of People leadership capability as the organization scales.
* Maintain close and consistent alignment with the U.S.\-based People Operations and global HR teams.
* Establish effective communication and collaboration practices across time zones, ensuring consistency in policies, employee experience, and people processes.
* Scale the People organization in line with business growth, workforce requirements, and evolving organizational needs.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 12\+ years of progressive experience in HR, People Operations, Talent Acquisition, or People leadership, including experience building or scaling a People function, business unit, capability center, or technology organization in India.
* Proven experience partnering with a U.S.\-headquartered technology organization and supporting senior leaders across India and the United States.
* Strong understanding of the Bangalore technology talent market, including software engineering, infrastructure, QA, data engineering, analytics, and shared services.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing high\-volume and specialized talent acquisition strategies in competitive talent markets.
* Experience establishing scalable HR policies, employee handbooks, governance frameworks, and People Operations processes for an India\-based workforce.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian employment practices, HR compliance, and applicable labor regulations, with the judgment to engage legal counsel when required.
* Proven experience building organizational culture, improving employee engagement, and developing retention strategies during periods of rapid growth or organizational change.
* Demonstrated experience hiring, leading, and developing HR or People teams.
* Strong executive presence, with the ability to influence and advise senior leaders across cultures, functions, and geographies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to use workforce data and people metrics to support business decisions.
* Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.
* Willingness to work remotely during the launch phase and transition to on\-site leadership in Bangalore once the office is operational.
* Ability to maintain effective working\-hour overlap with U.S.\-based teams.



  





**Strongly Preferred** 



* Experience in healthcare technology, healthcare intelligence, health insurance technology, payment integrity, or another regulated and data\-intensive industry.
* Proven U.S.–India cross\-border experience, including working within a U.S.\-parented organization, managing U.S.–India reporting relationships, or serving in a global People leadership role.
* Experience supporting private\-equity\-backed, high\-growth, or acquisitive organizations.
* Experience launching or scaling a new India business unit, Global Capability Center (GCC), or technology operation from the ground up.
* Familiarity with HR technology implementations, including Workday or comparable global HRIS platforms.
* Experience supporting teams that handle sensitive healthcare, financial, or other regulated data.
* Experience designing total rewards, career development, succession planning, and retention programs for highly sought\-after technical talent.
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Psychology, or a related field. An advanced degree or relevant HR certification is preferred.
* High ownership, adaptability, and energy, with the ability to grow into a broader India leadership remit as the organization scales.

title: Senior Associate Compensation & Rewards
description:
**Overview**
 Founded in 1988, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders and investors seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to help them scale their business and make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit. As the largest master servicer of commercial real estate loans in the United States, Trimont manages securitizations with meticulous oversight and coordination—protecting cash flows, mitigating risk, and ensuring portfolio performance.
   

  

 We do this with a team of 1100\+ extraordinary team members who serve a global client base from offices in Atlanta (headquarters), Bengaluru, Charlotte, Dallas, Hyderabad, Kansas City, London, New York and Sydney. We empower our people with advanced technology, industry\-leading knowledge, and a culture centered on our core values. This approach enables our teams to deliver exceptional client service, build lasting relationships and take pride in the high\-quality work they perform.
   

  

 Trimont is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.
   

  

**Learn:** 
 We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.
   

  

**Grow:** 
 We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry's most challenging and exciting endeavors.
   

  

**Thrive:** 
 Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members and as an organization, can achieve together.
   

  

*Where people, purpose, and progress come together every day.*
**Job Summary**
 The Senior Associate Compensation oversees the design, implementation, governance, and administration of compensation programs aligned with the organization’s talent strategy and business goals. This role maintains a scalable job architecture, leads compensation benchmarking and survey activities, and manages the annual year\-end compensation cycle. The position works closely with People \& Culture, Finance, business leaders, and HRIS teams to ensure programs are competitive, equitable, compliant, financially responsible, and consistently applied.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, governance, and ongoing management of job architecture, including job families, career tracks, levels, titles, grades, and advancement criteria.
* Evaluate roles, maintain salary structures and market ranges, and recommend titles, grades, pay ranges, and compensation actions using consistent methodology.
* Conduct compensation benchmarking, manage survey participation and vendor relationships, and analyze market data to support competitive and equitable pay decisions.
* Manage the annual compensation cycle, including merit increases, promotions, market adjustments, incentives, budgeting, approvals, communications, and reporting.
* Partner with People \& Culture, Finance, HRIS, payroll, recruiters, and business leaders on compensation decisions, internal equity, organizational design, and process execution.
* Develop dashboards, executive\-ready analyses, and recurring reports that translate compensation data into actionable insights.
* Maintain compensation policies, documentation, audit controls, pay equity support, and compliance practices while handling confidential information with discretion.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 4\+ years of progressive experience in compensation or total rewards, with direct responsibility for job architecture, market pricing, compensation surveys, and annual compensation cycles.
* Proven experience designing and maintaining salary structures, grades, ranges, and job\-leveling frameworks.
* Strong understanding of compensation principles, market data analysis, internal equity, pay governance, and relevant regulations.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis; experience with HRIS and compensation planning platforms required (UKG experience preferred).
* Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) or similar credential preferred.
* Experience supporting international or multi\-jurisdictional employee populations preferred.
* Demonstrated analytical skills and sound business judgment.
* Strong project and process management abilities.
* Effective stakeholder management and consultative partnership skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive\-level communication.
* High attention to detail, data accuracy, and internal controls.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and make sensitive decisions.
* Commitment to fairness, consistency, confidentiality, and continuous improvement.


 Trimont is an equal opportunity employer, and we are proud to support and celebrate diversity in the workplace. If you have a disability and need an accommodation or assistance with the application process or use of our website, please contact us. Trimont maintains a drug\-free workplace and is committed to providing a safe, secure, and productive environment for all team members.

title: Senior HRBP
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an HR Business Partner for India, you'll work closely with the Director of People – APAC to support our Bangalore based teams through a period of rapid growth. You will enable leaders to achieve their business goals through their people \- building the capacity of the organization to attract, develop, and retain talent while ensuring every decision holds up against India's statutory and regulatory framework.
   

  

 This role combines strategic HRBP partnership with hands\-on ownership of India\-specific compliance, employee relations, and operational rigor. You'll be a trusted advisor to business leaders and a steady, empathetic presence for employees, while working closely with Payroll \& Compliance, Talent Acquisition, and Total Rewards to deliver a consistent employee experience.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Business Partnership
   

  

* Conduct regular cadence meetings with your assigned business unit(s), acting as the primary People point of contact for leaders and employees.
* Provide compensation and leveling guidance to business unit leaders, in partnership with Total Rewards, anchored to India market benchmarks and internal equity.
* Analyze workforce trends and metrics \- attrition, hiring, promotions, engagement \- in partnership with the People Operations team to develop solutions, programs, and policies.
* Drive business unit organizational design and talent strategy to achieve business objectives, including headcount planning and role scoping.


 Employee Relations \& Compliance
   

  

* Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues; conduct thorough, objective, and well\-documented investigations.
* Maintain in\-depth, current knowledge of Indian labor law \- including the Shops and Establishments Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Payment of Gratuity Act, POSH Act, and the New Labour Codes as they come into force \- to reduce legal risk and ensure regulatory compliance across Karnataka and any other state of operation.
* Partner with Payroll \& HR Compliance and external legal counsel as needed on statutory matters, notices, and filings.
* Own or contribute to background verification (BGV) exception handling and RAG\-based risk assessment for your business unit, in line with company policy.
* Provide day\-to\-day performance management guidance to managers \- coaching, counseling, career development, and disciplinary action \- consistent with Indian employment norms and documentation standards.
* Work closely with management and employees to improve working relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Provide HR policy guidance and interpretation, flagging gaps between global policy and India\-specific legal requirements.


 Talent, Training \& Culture
   

  

* Identify training needs for business units and individual coaching needs for people managers; monitor and follow up on training and upskilling objectives.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for your business unit, partnering with Onboarding \& Ops on a smooth, compliant employee lifecycle.
* Gather and report on metrics related to retention, promotion, hiring, and diversity for your client group.
* Help build and refine India People Ops systems and processes \- you'll help write a policy when one doesn't yet exist.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 8\+ years of experience as an HRBP, with a strong point of view on how HRBPs move a business forward; experience at a fast\-growing technology or insurance company is a plus.
* In\-depth working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance \- PF, ESI, gratuity, statutory bonus, Karnataka Shops \& Establishments Act, and the New Labour Codes. Prior exposure to a multi\-state India compliance footprint is a strong plus.
* Experience managing complex employee relations cases, including conducting investigations and resolving disputes; experience partnering with Underwriting, Engineering, or another regulated business function is a plus.
* Working knowledge of multiple HR disciplines \- organizational design, learning and development, compensation, HR technology, and data management.
* Exposure to a matrixed or multi\-country People team structure (e.g., partnering across India, Singapore, or the US) is a plus.
* You are an empathetic listener who can build trust quickly and hold it, even in difficult conversations.
* You are data\-driven \- able to back up your recommendations to client groups with solid data and clear reasoning.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced, first\-principles environment and see the ambiguity of a scaling company as an exciting challenge rather than a blocker.
* You are a strong communicator, comfortable representing the People function to senior stakeholders.
* You have a genuine passion for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Bachelor's degree required; a postgraduate qualification in HR or a related field is preferred.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
   

  

 To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
   

  

***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

 20\+ years
   

  

**About Link Logistics (a Blackstone Company)**
 Link Logistics is a leading owner and operator of last\-mile industrial real estate, with a large portfolio across key North American markets. Founded by Blackstone in 2019, Link Logistics combines institutional scale with local expertise, proprietary data and a fast\-moving, collaborative culture operating at the intersection of real estate, technology, data and sustainability.
   

  

 As Link Logistics expands its capabilities in Bengaluru, we are building a team that will play an important role in supporting the company’s continued growth, innovation and global operating model.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Link Logistics is seeking an accomplished and entrepreneurial
 **Director, Business Partner Advisory, Link Logistics India** 
 to establish and lead the people and talent agenda for its Bengaluru organization.
   

  

 This is a highly visible, hands\-on leadership role for an individual who can operate simultaneously as a strategic advisor, organizational architect, talent acquisition leader and execution\-focused builder. The Director will create the long\-term people strategy for the Bengaluru organization while designing and leading the full employee lifecycle, from workforce planning and employer positioning through recruitment, onboarding, development, engagement, performance and retention.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring approximately 20 or more years of progressive HR and talent leadership experience, including meaningful experience in start\-up, greenfield or rapidly scaling environments. This leader must be equally comfortable advising senior executives, building new programs, solving complex organizational challenges and personally driving critical work when needed.
   

  

 The Director will serve as the senior HR leader and principal people advisor for the Link Logistics India organization and advisor to Head of Link India. The role will partner closely with the central entity P\&C team, which provides core HR processes, policies and operational support. title: Human Resources Director
description:
**About Flipkart** 




  





 Flipkart is India's leading e\-commerce marketplace, serving 500 million\+ registered customers and enabling millions of sellers, logistics partners, and brands. We are building the commerce infrastructure of India — powered by technology, data, and an unrelenting focus on the customer. Our people are the engine behind this mission.
 



  





**Role Context** 




 The Director – HRBP for OneTech is a strategic leadership role at the intersection of people, technology, and organizational effectiveness. This leader will serve as the primary HR partner to senior Engineering and Product leadership — shaping the talent and culture agenda for the teams building Flipkart's core technology platforms.
 



 This is not a traditional HR role. It demands a strategic, execution\-oriented, and data\-fluent HR leader who can influence at the CXO level, navigate organizational complexity at scale, and drive people agendas that directly accelerate engineering velocity and product outcomes.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Business Partnership** 



* Serve as a trusted thought partner to Engineering VPs, Product heads, and their leadership teams — present in business reviews, roadmap planning, and leadership forums.
* Translate business and technology strategy into people priorities: talent, structure, culture, and capability roadmaps aligned to 1–3 year engineering and product goals.
* Understand how product orgs operate — squads, platforms, roadmaps, — and bring HR interventions that map to how engineering actually works.



  





  





**Organizational Design \& Effectiveness** 



* Lead org design across engineering and product functions: platform team structures, squad models, span of control, layer optimization, and role architecture that scales with growth.
* Drive workforce planning in partnership with Finance and TA — headcount modelling, skills gap analysis, and build\-buy\-borrow decisions across technology stacks and domains.
* Facilitate restructuring, team integrations (post\-M\&A), and transformation programs within the vertical.



**Talent Strategy \& Leadership Development** 



* Own the talent agenda for engineering and product: succession planning, high\-potential identification, critical role coverage, and retention of senior engineers and PMs.
* Partner with L\&D to design leadership development pathways for tech leads, senior ICs, engineering managers, and directors.
* Drive a differentiated EVP narrative tailored to attract senior engineering and product talent in a competitive market.



**Culture, Engagement \& DEI** 



* Champion a high\-performance, inclusive engineering culture — using engagement data to diagnose friction and design targeted interventions.
* Lead DEI action planning within client groups, with measurable outcomes on representation across engineering levels and product leadership.
* Act as a culture anchor during periods of change — leadership transitions, org restructures, M\&A integration.



**Performance \& Total Rewards** 



* Anchor the annual performance cycle for the function — calibration, differentiation, and quality of feedback, including IC vs. management tracks.
* Partner with Compensation to design benchmarking, off\-cycle corrections, and incentive structuring for specialized roles (Staff/Principal engineers, Distinguished architects, senior PMs).



**Employee Relations** 



* Handle complex ER matters within the function — investigations, disciplinary actions, and sensitive people issues — with discretion and sound judgment.
* Ensure HR practices comply with applicable labour laws and internal governance frameworks.



**People Analytics \& HR Operating Model** 



* Use workforce and engagement data to generate insights and drive evidence\-based decisions — attrition risk, org health signals, span/layer diagnostics.
* Continuously sharpen HR operating rhythms: governance cadences, HRBP\-to\-business touchpoints, and HR service delivery for the function.
* Represent OneTech HR requirements in cross\-functional CoE forums (policy design, HRIS improvements, comp frameworks).



  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Experience** 



* 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 10\+ years as a senior HRBP directly supporting large Engineering or Product organizations.
* Demonstrated success partnering with CXOs and senior technical leaders in a fast\-paced, high\-growth technology or e\-commerce environment.
* Experience managing HR for organizations with significant engineering headcount (500\+) and product\-led business models.
* Prior exposure to M\&A integration, org transformation, or post\-restructuring stabilization in a tech context is strongly preferred.



**Functional Capabilities** 



* Deep HRBP expertise: org design, talent management, performance, compensation, ER, and culture — with specific fluency in how these apply to engineering orgs.
* Ability to speak the language of engineering and product: understands agile ways of working, platform thinking, IC career ladders, and tech hiring dynamics.
* Strong proficiency in workforce analytics and HR metrics; comfortable with data\-driven storytelling to senior technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law and HR compliance relevant to large technology organizations.



**Leadership \& Personal Attributes** 



* Executive presence: capable of holding a room with senior engineering leaders, pushing back constructively, and influencing without authority.
* High learning agility — able to quickly absorb context across diverse technology domains and connect dots across business units.
* Operates with discretion, confidentiality, and sound judgment.
* Collaborative but decisive; brings clarity and calm during periods of ambiguity and change.
* Resilient, self\-aware, and genuinely invested in the growth of the teams they support.



  





  





**Why Flipkart** 



* Shape the people agenda for the engineering teams building India's commerce, payments, and supply chain infrastructure.
* Partner with leaders solving problems at a scale few technology organizations in India operate at.
* Work in an HR function with CoE depth, real data maturity, and a genuine seat at the business table.
* Competitive compensation, ESOP participation, and a high\-velocity growth environment.
* A culture that values directness, intellectual curiosity, and impact over hierarchy.

title: Specialist - HR Operations
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear \- to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
   

  

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
   

  

 We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
   

  

 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 This role ( Specialist \- HR Operations) is the operational backbone of our employee experience across multiple entities. You will play a crucial role in managing our HR operations, Vendor management, Benefit administratement, payroll, compliance, audits and general HR functions and You will solve complex compliance and lifecycle challenges, ensuring our internal HR engine runs flawlessly as we scale. It's an exciting opportunity to build scalable workflows, bridge the gap between HR and other cross functional teams.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Payroll Management : Oversee and manage the end\-to\-end in house payroll process, ensuring timely and accurate salary payments, deductions, and tax saving benefits administration. Maintain accurate and confidential payroll records and documentation.
* Tax Reporting : Prepare and file all required tax documents and reports, including quarterly and annual tax filings, 24Q to generate form 16 and other related forms.
* Payroll Reporting : Generate and share payroll reports in prescribed formats, including payroll summaries, tax reports, and compliance reports etc with the finance team.
* Audits and Reviews : Conduct regular payroll audits to ensure accuracy and compliance. Prepare for internal and external audits as required.
* Statutory compliance : Ensure timely preparation and payment of Statutory dues (PF, ESIC, LWF etc) and filling of paid challans.
* Compliance : Ensure adherence to all relevant employment laws and regulations. Conduct regular audits to maintain compliance and address any discrepancies or issues.
* Benefits Administration : Ensure accurate payroll deductions of employee benefits and timely process the payment to respective partners to record in employees wallets/accounts. Support Wellness benefits including health insurance, wellness benefits etc.
* Vendor Management: You’ll be the go\-to person for all things related to our HR vendors and consultants. From the moment we decide to partner with someone new, you’ll take the reins—guiding them through onboarding, sorting out NDAs and InfoSec approvals, and getting their agreements finalized. You’ll also keep track of when contracts are up for renewal and handle them smoothly via Spotdraft. But your impact doesn't stop at contracts; you’ll be deeply involved in the financial side of things, too. You’ll run the PR\-PO workflows on NetSuite, process invoices, reconcile accounts, and keep our HR Expense Tracker perfectly organized so we always know exactly where things stand.
* HR Operations : Support daily HR operations, including employee onboarding, records management, and HRIS maintenance. Act as a point of contact for HR\-related inquiries. Work closely with other HR team members and departments to ensure seamless integration of HR processes and support organizational goals.
* HR System Management : Administrate and update HRMS as per the requirement. Implement and test system upgrades and changes to ensure continued accuracy and efficiency.
* Dashboard and Reporting : Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reports to track key metrics, identify trends, and provide insights.
* Project Management : Lead and participate in HR projects aimed at improving operational efficiency and employee satisfaction. Manage project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.
* Attention to Detail : Maintain high levels of accuracy in all aspects of payroll processing, compliance, and reporting. Identify and resolve issues proactively. Ensure compliance with data protection regulations.


**You’ll Excel in This Role If You Have:**
* Think in first principles and act like an owner, taking absolute accountability for sensitive data and compliance deadlines.
* Possess a sharp eye for numerical accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.
* Communicate with precision and empathy, effectively resolving employee queries and collaborating with external vendors.
* Thrive in a fast\-paced environment, seamlessly balancing the operational needs of multiple entities.
* Have a strong bias for action and efficient problem\-solving, turning operational bottlenecks into streamlined processes.
* Navigate ambiguity with ease, staying proactively updated on evolving state gazettes and labor laws.


 ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿
   

  

**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**
* You’re delivering 100% error\-free and on\-time monthly payroll and statutory filings with zero compliance defaults or penalties.
* You’ve established a frictionless benefits administration process, consistently resolving employee queries and enrollments within targeted SLAs.
* You’ve successfully streamlined the PR\-PO and vendor onboarding workflows, resulting in fully reconciled and up\-to\-date HR expense trackers.
* You’ve elevated the new joiner orientation experience, ensuring all statutory forms, COCs, and compliance declarations are seamlessly executed on day one.


**Why This Role Matters \& What’s In It For You**
 As the anchor of our HR team, Your work directly ensures that the people building CoinDCX feel genuinely supported, cared for, and paid on time, all while keeping our company safe and compliant. Along the way, you’ll get incredible hands\-on experience managing HR and finance workflows across multiple entities. This is a special chance to shape how we care for our team from the ground up, doing meaningful work in an industry that's changing the world.
   

  

**Hiring Process:**
 Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round –A take\-home task or live problem\-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long\-term fit


**Where We Work:**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organisation. This role is based out of our
 **Bangalore** 
 office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You:**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities


**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
 If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Regional Learning Manager, ATS
description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Learning \& Development (L\&D) team within IN ATS Operations is seeking a highly experienced and results\-oriented Learning Manager to lead and scale strategic L\&D initiatives across our rapidly growing operations network. This is a pivotal role that sits at the intersection of talent strategy, learning innovation, and operational excellence — directly influencing how Amazon builds, develops, and retains world\-class talent at scale.
   

  

 The role will own end\-to\-end program management of high\-impact initiatives spanning the full L\&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single\-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.
   

  

 This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L\&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L\&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Hiring Strategy: Own the end\-to\-end L\&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role\-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.
   

  

 ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism\-based interventions.
   

  

 Capability Building (GB \& BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.
   

  

 Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross\-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.
   

  

 QBR \& OP1: Prepare and present L\&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.
   

  

 Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high\-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.
   

  

 Content Development: Own the end\-to\-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.
   

  

 Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.
   

  

 Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.
   

  

 L\&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L\&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams
* Experience developing and implementing training programs
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience creating learning content and driving learning through a Learning Management System

title: Workplace Experience Manager
description:
**Workplace Experience Manager** 




  




* **Drive workplace engagement, space optimization, and hybrid work initiatives**
* **Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Workplace Experience and Front of House team**
* **Provide strategic leadership and operational oversights.**



  





***Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position.***




**About the role** 




  





 The
 **Workplace Experience Manager (W\-I)** 
 is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership across our global capability and support facilities in Bangalore, championing an exceptional, customer\-first workplace environment for all Woolworths Group brands and team members.
 



 In this role, you will lead, coach, and inspire a high\-performing on\-site Workplace Experience and Front of House team, as well as manage integrated vendor partnerships. You will bridge physical workplace operations, hospitality, and modern hybrid ways of working—curating an environment that drives collaboration, culture, and operational resilience. Serving as the primary operational anchor and senior escalation point on site, you will oversee end\-to\-end service delivery, soft facilities management, space utilization, and workplace engagement programs, ensuring seamless alignment between Bangalore operations and global enterprise standards.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




**Leadership \& Team Development** 



* Lead, manage, and develop a team of workplace professionals, ensuring their behaviors and KPIs align with our customer\-centric service goals.
* Embody strong leadership, actively coaching and developing leadership capabilities within your team.
* Take accountability for team growth and development, ensuring the right talent is recruited and nurtured. This includes establishing development plans and providing ongoing day\-to\-day management to achieve our workplace strategy.
* Focus on building a strong, diverse talent pipeline and fostering an inclusive team environment.
* Engage in ongoing feedback sessions with your Line Manager and team to continuously refine business strategy and personal leadership development.



  





**Customer Focus \& Values** 



* Create and cultivate an environment that prioritizes the team, actively using stakeholder feedback to achieve our goals of being proactive, responsive, and efficient.
* Act with authenticity and integrity, consistently demonstrating desired behaviors.
* Challenge the status quo with positive intent, always adhering to Woolworths Core Values and ways of working.
* Commit to bringing a little good to everyone, every day.



  





**What you’ll bring** 




**Strategic planning \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Workplace Roadmap Execution: Develop and deliver an evolving Workplace Experience Roadmap for the Bangalore campus that mirrors global enterprise standards while tailoring activations to local site needs.
* Space Utilization \& Analytics: Monitor and evaluate attendance trends, desk utilization, meeting room usage, and workplace feedback to recommend proactive space reconfigurations and operational improvements.
* Continuous Innovation: Challenge the status quo by introducing modern workplace hospitality standards, digital self\-service tools, and streamlined administrative workflows.
* Sustainability \& Wellness: Champion sustainability practices across office operations (waste reduction, energy conservation, green initiatives) and coordinate wellness amenities that support team well\-being.



  





**Daily Office Operations** 



* Welcoming Concierge \& Visitor Management: Oversee reception, front\-of\-house hospitality, and visitor management systems, ensuring VIP guests, partners, and team members receive a polished, seamless welcome.
* Workplace Readiness \& Standards: Ensure shared collaborative spaces, quiet focus zones, meeting rooms, and team hubs are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness, functionality, and brand presentation.
* Onboarding \& Employee Experience: Partner with People \& Culture and IT to execute a frictionless first\-day workplace orientation, desk setup, and facility access experience for all new hires.
* Supplies, Inventory \& Asset Care: Manage office supplies, kitchen amenities, mail/courier operations, asset registers, and workplace lockers with robust tracking and budget control.



  





**Events, Culture \& Community Management** 



* Internal Events \& Activations: Plan and execute impactful campus events, town halls, cultural celebrations, leadership visits, and team\-building activations in partnership with cross\-functional leaders.
* Community Engagement: Implement a vibrant "Community Management" model across floors to gather employee pulse feedback, drive belonging, and champion the Woolworths Voice of Team (VOT) program.
* Cross\-Site Collaboration: Coordinate logistics for visiting global executives, providing executive\-level support, meeting coordination, and hospitality arrangements.



  





**Vendor Management \& Soft Facilities Services** 



* Vendor Partnerships \& SLAs: Oversee performance, SLAs, and commercial governance for outsourced service partners, including commercial cleaning, security, catering, indoor plants, waste management, and pest control.
* Budget Oversight \& Commercial Discipline: Manage the site soft\-services operational budget (OPEX), approve service invoices, and identify efficiency opportunities without compromising safety or quality.
* Safety, Compliance \& Emergency Preparedness: Partner with Facilities Management and Health \& Safety teams to manage site WHS compliance, statutory obligations, emergency response drills, and Business Continuity Plans (BCP).



  





**Leadership \& Team development** 



* People Leadership: Lead, coach, and nurture a diverse team of Workplace Coordinators, Receptionists, and facility leads; conduct regular 1:1 check\-ins, performance reviews, and career development planning.
* Service Mindset Culture: Foster an inclusive, proactive, "can\-do" culture dedicated to customer first, team first service excellence.
* Capability Building: Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ongoing training programs for workplace operations and customer service consistency.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Collaborate with primary business partners to design and execute strategic roadmaps driving targeted workplace environment programs.
* Engage alongside 360 Workplace leadership and broader Woolworths 360 functions to deliver core organizational goals and outcomes.
* Foster enduring vendor relationships with external service vendors, maintaining seamless delivery standards and strict SLA adherence across all support facilities



  





**Experience** 



* Relevant Track Record: 12\+ years of progressive experience in Workplace Operations, Corporate Office Management, Hospitality, or Customer Experience leadership within a fast\-paced corporate or multinational enterprise.
* People Leadership: Proven success managing, coaching, and developing front\-of\-house or operations teams with demonstrable talent development outcomes.
* Matrix \& Global Environment: Experience operating in global capability centers (GCCs) or matrixed organizations, collaborating across different geographies and time zones.
* Event \& Project Execution: Strong project management background orchestrating large\-scale internal events, office moves/fit\-outs, or operational transformation initiatives.
* Vendor \& Financial Acumen: Demonstrated capability managing third\-party vendor contracts, SLAs, purchase orders, and departmental budgets.
* Tech\-Savvy Operations: Familiarity with modern workplace tools (e.g., Google Workspace, desk/room reservation software, visitor management systems, ServiceNow, or enterprise FM systems like Maximo).



  





**What you’ll experience** 



* Be a part of Australia’s largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous performance based bonus
* 20 days annual leave
* A flexible approach to work
* Premium insurance coverage for you and your dependants



  





**Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group** 




 Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.

If your application is successful, Zinnov and/ or Woolworths Group will also use your personal information, including sensitive personal information, for managing your ongoing working relationship.
