title: Trainer - India
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
 Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000\-year data gap” — the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments — kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes — to capture the high\-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more \[here]
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and deliver on a learning curriculum for the Operations team that aligns with Instawork’s business objectives and scales with a growing organization; coordinate and administer training
* Develop a comprehensive onboarding program that encourages new team members to provide premier support for Instawork’s customers and internal stakeholders, as well as prepare them for an intensive operational role managing high volume and nuanced customer requests
* Collaborate with management to create training plans, develop training modules, and facilitate real\-time training for Operations new hires and continuing education for tenured specialists
* Manage the efficacy of new hire onboarding through continuous process planning, execution, and identifying metrics for the Operations learning curriculum
* Establish methods for measuring and reporting on learner engagement, comprehension, and practical application
* Provide consistent visibility through written status and ongoing reporting, summarizing learner developmen
* Develop learning exercises with specific examples of interactions that promote empathy and obsession with the customer experience
* Create and assist with managing content for the Operations for the internal customer Knowledge Base and external customer Help Center


**Who You Are**
* 6\+ months of experience leading and creating support training programs
* 6\+ months leading remote or diverse teams, preferably in the technology services industry
* Experience creating content for and publishing within a Content or Learning Management System
* Proven ability to utilize different strategies to engage learners through presentation, facilitation and mentorship, as well as use of online and offline training concepts
* Demonstrated success managing long\-term projects and ongoing reporting for deliverables
* Proven ability to motivate, influence and work effectively at all organizational levels using different methods of communication
* Experience collaborating with distributed teams across multiple time zones and languages and cultures strongly preferred Learning Management System (LMS) administration experience preferred


**Preferred Languages**
* Fluent in English and at least one of the following regional languages: Marathi, Telugu, or Kannada.


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Director - HRBP (Tech)
description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being India's most successful D2C food\-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac customers with our de\-licious fresh meat and seafood! Think you have what it takes to be the magic ingredient in the recipe that is Licious? Read on...
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The Director HRBP (Tech) will own the people agenda for Licious' Product, Analytics, Engineering and Data teams, a span of roughly 200 people building the technology that powers India's most loved meat and seafood brand. You will own the full HRBP charter for Tech: raising the talent bar, lifting talent density, shaping how people experience Licious every day and building the leadership ecosystem this company will need as it scales. Alongside the HRBP mandate you will own a critical COE charter for the wider organisation, with Performance Management being a strong possibility, giving you the chance to shape practice well beyond your own business unit.
 



  





 This role demands someone who is equally at home in a leadership review and in a 1:1 with an engineer two weeks into the job. Tech at Licious is growing fast, the environment moves quickly and the answers are rarely sitting in a playbook. You will need to think like a business leader, build credibility quickly with a sharp and analytical set of stakeholders, use data as your default language and be comfortable building things from scratch, iterating in the open and holding your point of view when it matters.
 



  





**Have you got an awesome appetite for?** 




  





**Talent Bar and Talent Density** 



* Raising the talent bar across Product, Analytics, Engineering and Data by partnering closely with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition on role design, calibration and interview rigour.
* Building a clear and honest view of talent density across the function: knowing where the strength sits, where the gaps are and what it will take to close them.
* Driving internal development, mobility and succession so critical roles have credible internal successors and not only external pipelines.
* Owning workforce planning for Tech, keeping headcount, skills and structure aligned to the product and engineering roadmap.



**Employee Experience and Org Connectedness** 



* Shaping how people experience Licious through continuous listening: surveys, skip levels, focus groups and the informal channels that surface the real signal.
* Building belonging across product and engineering pods so people feel part of one org and one mission rather than a set of separate teams.
* Translating listening data into action plans with named owners, clear timelines and follow through people can actually see.
* Partnering on rituals, forums and communication that keep Tech connected to the business, the consumer and the food.



**Leadership Ecosystem and Capability Building** 



* Building the leadership ecosystem Licious needs to execute and scale: identifying, developing and coaching managers and senior leaders across Tech.
* Coaching leaders through team design, difficult conversations, performance calls and their own growth.
* Partnering with L\&D to build manager capability, so first time managers and experienced leaders both get what they need.
* Keeping the organisation transformation ready by anticipating structure, capability and culture needs ahead of time rather than reacting to them.



**COE Ownership** 



* Owning a company wide COE mandate alongside the HRBP charter, with Performance Management being a strong possibility.
* Building or reshaping the performance philosophy, cycle design, calibration approach and the manager enablement that has to go with it.
* Driving adoption across business units, holding a consistent bar and making the process something managers find genuinely useful.
* Measuring the impact of the COE charter through data and improving it every cycle.



**Business Partnership and Culture** 



* Partnering with Tech leadership as a real thought partner on org design, capability, culture and business priorities.
* Driving culture as an outcome rather than a slogan: making Licious values visible in how decisions get made, how feedback travels and how people are recognised.
* Using people data to spot attrition risk, engagement dips and structural issues early, and bringing solutions rather than dashboards.
* Handling employee relations and sensitive matters with fairness, speed and discretion.



  





**We hope that you have..** 



* Bring 10 to 14 years of HR experience with strong HRBP depth, including meaningful time partnering Product, Engineering, Analytics or Data teams.
* Have owned an HRBP charter for a span of 150 people or more, ideally in a high growth consumer tech, ecommerce or product led environment.
* Bring real COE experience, ideally Performance Management, whether that meant building a framework from scratch or fixing one that had stopped working.
* Have a clear point of view on talent density and can talk specifically about how you raised the bar, what changed as a result and what it cost you to get there.
* Are comfortable with ambiguity and leadership transitions, and can hold a team steady while the org around it is still taking shape.
* Have used listening mechanisms seriously: you know how to run them, how to read what they are really saying and how to convert them into visible action.
* Are data fluent and can build a case with numbers in a room full of analytical people who will ask you exactly where the number came from.
* Are a credible coach to senior leaders and can push back on a founder or a function head without damaging the relationship.
* Bring a strong bias for execution: you build, ship, measure and improve instead of waiting for the perfect plan.
* Are excited about building the people engine for a brand that is changing how India eats, and are ready to be hands on to do it.

description:
**WHO ARE WE?** 




 We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!
 



 CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real\-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.
 



 Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:
 



**CloudSEK's Product Suite** 



* **CloudSEK XVigil** 
 constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* **CloudSEK's BeVigil** 
 is a powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. It uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* **CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil** 
 identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third\-party dependencies.



**Key Milestones** 



* **2016:** 
 Launched our first product.
* **2018:** 
 Secured Pre\-series A funding.
* **2019:** 
 Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* **2020:** 
 Won the NASSCOM\-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* **2021:** 
 Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* **Awards \& Recognition:** 
 Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* **2025:** 
 Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.



  





**About the job** 




 At CloudSEK, performance, culture, and happiness are not separate — they are deeply linked.
 



 We are building a company where people do the best work of their careers, and we want someone who owns that outcome end\-to\-end.
 



  





 The Chief Happiness Officer(Director/AVP HR) is accountable for keeping our teams engaged, motivated, focused, and performing at a high level — while ensuring we retain our best people and build a culture that compounds over time.
 



  





 This is not a “feel\-good HR” role. This is a systems \+ culture \+ performance role.
 



  





**What you will own** 




  





 1\. Measure what matters
 



 You will build the instrumentation to continuously track:
 



 • Engagement, morale, burnout, and energy levels
 



 • Manager effectiveness and team health
 



 • Attrition risk, regretted exits, and retention of top performers
 



 • Alignment to company mission, clarity of goals, and execution focus
 



  





 You will turn these into dashboards, signals, and early\-warning systems — not once\-a\-year surveys.
 



  





 2\. Build feedback and improvement loops
 



 You will design and run:
 



 • Continuous feedback systems (pulse surveys, 1:1 frameworks, skip\-levels)
 



 • Clear escalation and resolution loops for friction, conflict, and disengagement
 



 • Manager coaching programs to improve leadership quality across the company
 



  





 Your job is to detect problems early and fix them before they impact execution.
 



  





 3\. Identify, grow, and retain top performers
 



 You will:
 



 • Build a clear, fair system to identify high performers and high\-potential talent
 



 • Ensure top performers are recognized, rewarded, and developed faster than the rest
 



 • Design retention strategies for critical talent
 



 • Work with leadership on promotions, growth paths, and succession planning
 



  





 Your outcome: our best people feel seen, valued, and challenged — not ignored or burned out.
 



  





 4\. Design a culture that scales
 



 You will:
 



 • Codify and reinforce our cultural values through rituals, stories, and behavior systems
 



 • Ensure culture is consistent across geographies, teams, and growth stages
 



 • Remove incentives and behaviors that create politics, fear, or low\-trust environments
 



 • Build a company where speed, ownership, integrity, and excellence are the norm
 



  





 Culture is not posters — it’s what people do when no one is watching. You will shape that.
 



  





 5\. Partner with leadership on org design and people strategy
 



 You will work closely with:
 



 • The CEO and leadership team on org health and structure
 



 • Managers on team effectiveness and leadership quality
 



 • HR / People Ops on compensation, performance, and growth systems
 



  





 You will bring data, insight, and perspective to leadership — not just execution.
 



  





**What success looks like** 




 • High engagement and energy across teams
 



 • Low regretted attrition, especially among top performers
 



 • Managers who are trusted, effective, and respected
 



 • A culture that attracts strong talent and repels low\-integrity behavior
 



 • A company where people do great work and want to stay
 



  





**Who you are** 




 • 12\+ years in people leadership, culture, org design, or performance roles (startup / tech preferred)
 



 • Strong systems thinker — you can design feedback loops, metrics, and processes
 



 • Deep empathy \+ high standards — you care about people, but you don’t tolerate mediocrity
 



 • Comfortable with data, dashboards, and analytics
 



 • Confident influencing senior leaders and holding them accountable
 



 • High integrity, low ego, extremely trustworthy
 



 • You genuinely care about helping people do their best work
 



  





**Benefits of Joining CloudSEK** 




 We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:
 


* Flexible working hours.
* Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.
* And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!



  





**CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.**

title: Senior Executive – Learning & Development
description:
**Company: redBus**
**Function: Human Resources – Learning \& Development**
**Location: Bangalore\| Experience: 2–3 years**
**About The Role**
 As Senior Executive \- L\&D at redBus, you will drive skill development for employees across tech and non\-tech teams. You will identify skill gaps, design and deliver learning interventions to close them, and own the end\-to\-end process from finding and onboarding the right trainers and vendors to curating and delivering content in\-house. You will have cross\-functional exposure to identify and meet learning needs across the organization. Your work will ensure our people have the competencies they need to meet redBus's business goals, and that learning is embedded into how teams operate every day.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Skills \& Competency Framework**
* Own and maintain the skills and competency framework, keeping it current as roles and business needs evolve.
* Champion awareness of competencies and learning charters, and help individuals and teams use the framework to plan their development.
* Drive the rollout and adoption of learning frameworks across teams.


**Learning Design \& Delivery**
* Assess skill gaps across functions and design targeted interventions \- external training, internal programs, and blended or digital formats to address them.
* Curate and maintain an L\&D calendar for the Financial Year and ensure budget computations are in place.
* Organize and conduct training and awareness sessions, researching and delivering content in\-house where appropriate.
* Curate and maintain a library of relevant learning content and resources, with a focus on tech and product teams.
* Publish monthly and quarterly L\&D reports for audit and visibility purposes.
* Experiment with new formats and approaches to keep learning interventions impactful as business needs evolve. Show creativity and proactiveness in improving L\&D initiatives and delivery, not just limited to theory but practical takeaways.
* Capture feedback and monitor employee engagement during L\&D interventions.


**Vendor \& Trainer Management**
* Identify, evaluate, negotiate and onboard external vendors and trainers.
* Ensuring business relevance and alignment with external vendors.
* Manage ongoing vendor relationships, including quality, scheduling, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Ensuring adherence to organizational compliance while managing vendors.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Partner with team managers and HRBPs to integrate training plans into team activities and ensure adoption.
* Develop communication and engagement strategies that build visibility and enthusiasm for learning initiatives.
* Collaborate with the Admin to ensure logistics are arranged for the trainings and events accordingly.
* Update relevant stakeholders on the success metrics of L\&D initiatives, training impact, engagement levels and forward\-looking improvements through timely sharing of the feedback report.


**Measurement \& Improvement**
* Use data, dashboards, and analytics to track learning participation, progress, and outcomes.
* Refine programs and the competency framework based on what the data shows.
* Publish training summaries and way forward for the respective training conducted.


**Required**
**What You'll Bring**
* 2–3 years of L\&D experience, with a Master's degree in HR.
* Hands\-on experience managing or implementing competency frameworks.
* Experience designing learning initiatives and interventions with measurable impact.
* Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable engaging people across functional, technical, and operational areas.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort with data: Good with collecting, analyzing and representing data. Able to use dashboards and analytics to measure and improve learning outcomes.
* Experience managing vendor and trainer relationships.
* Familiarity with digital learning tools and platforms (LMS, e\-learning content, virtual delivery).
* Comfort with widely\-used AI tools in the HR domain.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a product\-based or high\-growth technology organization.
* Exposure to designing learning for technical and non technical audiences.


**Who Thrives Here**
 You're adaptable and energized by a fast\-paced environment. You are unafraid to take charge, can approach stakeholders confidently and are high on accountability. You understand the business context behind L\&D; how learning connects to broader organizational goals and you model continuous learning yourself.

title: Analyst
description:
symplr is seeking a FP\&A Analyst to provide embedded analytical support for the Technology/R\&D organization and help build the financial operating system for engineering investment, workforce planning, capitalization discipline, productivity, and technology cost structure.
   

  

 This Bangalore\-based role will partner with the Sr. Director, Engineering FP\&A, the U.S.\-based Engineering FP\&A Manager, Engineering leadership, Product \& Professional Services FP\&A, Accounting, HR, Procurement, and Corporate FP\&A to translate engineering activity, capacity, and cost drivers into accurate models, clear reporting, and useful business insight.
   

  

 The right candidate is hands\-on, analytically rigorous, highly curious, and comfortable going deep into workforce data, engineering spend, capitalization inputs, contractor/vendor analytics, cloud/tooling costs, and recurring FP\&A deliverables.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
**ENGINEERING FINANCE ANALYTICS \& BUSINESS SUPPORT**
* Support Engineering/R\&D FP\&A with recurring analysis, reporting, and decision support across workforce, capacity, roadmap investment, technical cost structure, and productivity.
* Translate engineering priorities, product/platform initiatives, security work, technical debt, AI/platform investments, and maintenance activity into clearly structured analysis and model inputs.
* Prepare monthly Engineering financial review materials, variance analysis, metrics packages, and supporting schedules for review with Engineering and FP\&A leadership.
* Partner with Product \& Professional Services FP\&A as needed to support analysis of roadmap affordability, product commitments, implementation implications, and build\-versus\-buy economics.


**PLANNING, FORECASTING \& MODELING**
* Maintain detailed Engineering/R\&D planning and forecast models in alignment with Corporate FP\&A templates, calendars, definitions, and submission standards.
* Build and update workforce models by team, location, product/platform area, initiative, employee/contractor mix, hiring status, and forecast period.
* Support monthly forecasting, annual planning, variance analysis, and scenario analysis for Engineering/R\&D spend, headcount, contractors, vendors, cloud/tooling, and other technology\-related costs.
* Prepare accurate, timely, and well\-documented forecast inputs that can be reviewed, consolidated, and explained by Engineering FP\&A leadership and Corporate FP\&A.


**CAPITALIZATION, COST STRUCTURE \& PRODUCTIVITY ANALYSIS**
* Support R\&D capitalization and OpEx/CapEx analysis by organizing inputs, tracking activity, maintaining supporting schedules, and partnering with Accounting/CAO under FP\&A leadership guidance.
* Analyze cloud, tooling, vendor, contractor, and technology infrastructure spend tied to engineering productivity and cost efficiency.
* Maintain reporting and analysis around R\&D spend as a percentage of revenue, cost by product/platform/initiative, capitalized versus expensed development, innovation versus maintenance capacity, and location mix.
* Support vendor rationalization, contractor mix, location strategy, and build\-versus\-buy analysis by preparing clean datasets, trends, comparisons, and scenario outputs.


**DATA, DASHBOARDS \& PROCESS DISCIPLINE**
* Create and maintain repeatable reports, dashboards, and analysis packs that improve visibility into Engineering investment, capacity, productivity, and trade\-offs.
* Ensure Engineering FP\&A outputs are accurate, traceable, clearly documented, and consistent with FP\&A definitions, KPI standards, model architecture, and version\-control expectations.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring analysis and reporting processes using planning tools, BI tools, and analytical automation.
* Maintain strong data hygiene across headcount, vendor, contractor, capitalization, cloud/tooling, and cost\-center reporting inputs.


**WAYS OF WORKING \& CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP**
* Develop deep fluency in Engineering/R\&D operations, technology cost drivers, and symplr’s product/platform investment model.
* Operate as an embedded tower resource rather than a generic shared\-services analyst, building enough functional depth to anticipate questions and improve analysis quality over time.
* Work collaboratively across U.S. and India time zones, balancing responsiveness with high\-quality, well\-organized analytical output.
* Bring curiosity, ownership, and continuous\-improvement mindset to a growing FP\&A function that is being built as an enterprise decision engine.


**Skills Required**
**Qualifications Required:**
* B com/ MBA in Finance \& Accounting


**Experience \& Background**
* 3\+ years of progressive finance, FP\&A, business finance, investment banking, corporate finance, consulting, analytics, or related experience.
* Experience supporting Engineering, Technology, Product, R\&D, SaaS, enterprise software, healthcare technology, or similarly complex operating environments preferred.
* Experience with workforce planning, headcount modeling, variance analysis, forecast support, vendor/contractor spend analysis, or management reporting strongly preferred.
* Exposure to PE\-backed, high\-growth, scaling, multi\-product, or operationally complex businesses is helpful but not required.


**Technical \& Analytical Capabilities**
* Strong financial modeling, Excel, analytical, and problem\-solving skills, with ability to manage detail while telling a clear business story.
* Working knowledge of workforce planning, scenario analysis, variance analysis, cost\-center reporting, vendor analytics, and productivity metrics.
* Familiarity with R\&D capitalization, OpEx/CapEx concepts, cloud/tooling cost analysis, and technology cost structures preferred.
* Comfortable working with planning systems, BI tools, ERP/financial systems, and large datasets; curiosity about automation and AI\-enabled analytical improvements.


**WAYS OF WORKING**
* Hands\-on analyst with strong ownership, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to ask why before accepting surface\-level answers.
* High attention to detail, strong documentation habits, and commitment to producing accurate, timely, and explainable work product.
* Clear communicator who can summarize analysis, risks, and drivers for finance and non\-finance stakeholders.
* Builder mindset with a bias toward practical process improvement, scalable reporting, and continuous learning.

 Panigrahana Weddings \| Bengaluru \| Full\-time, on\-site
 



  





 Build the HR function of a growing wedding planning and design business. We are looking for a hands\-on HR Business Partner who can turn people needs into practical systems, earn employees’ trust and hold managers accountable. You will own the employee lifecycle and help shape how the company hires, works, develops people and handles difficult conversations.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 • End\-to\-end recruitment: understand hiring needs, define roles, source talent, run structured interviews, coordinate offers and improve quality of hire.
 



 • Joining and onboarding: documentation, induction, role clarity, probation reviews and a consistent new\-joiner experience.
 



 • HR foundations: organisation structure, job descriptions, policies, employee records, attendance and leave processes, and reliable HR reporting.
 



 • Performance and development: clear expectations, review cycles, manager coaching, feedback and practical learning plans.
 



 • Employee relations: listen carefully, handle concerns confidentially, resolve conflict fairly and follow through on commitments.
 



 • Culture and retention: build everyday practices that support trust, accountability, recognition and effective collaboration across sales, design, planning and execution teams.
 



 • Exits: thoughtful exit interviews, handovers, documentation and coordination of final settlements; use the feedback to improve the workplace.
 



 • People operations: coordinate payroll inputs, benefits and applicable compliance with finance and specialist advisers.
 



  





 WHO WILL DO WELL HERE
 



 • You have independently handled both recruitment and broader HR operations, with examples of systems you built or improved.
 



 • You can work in a startup environment: create the process, implement it yourself and keep it usable as the business grows.
 



 • You combine emotional intelligence with sound judgment. You can be empathetic without avoiding difficult decisions, and direct without losing respect for people.
 



 • You are organised, discreet and comfortable working closely with founders and functional leaders.
 



 • Experience in hospitality, events, creative services or another people\-intensive business is helpful.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



 A dependable hiring pipeline, clear roles and onboarding, accurate people records, useful review routines, and employees who know where to raise concerns and receive follow\-through.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



 Apply with your CV. Please include a short example of an HR process you built from scratch and a people challenge you handled, without sharing confidential employee information. Tell us your current location and notice period.

title: Head of HR Operations & Recruitment
description:
ABOUT ARIVUPRO ACADEMY
   

 ArivuPro Academy is South India's leading commerce and professional\-certification academy, coaching students for CA, CS, CMA India, ACCA, CMA USA, CFA, CIA, CPA US, EA, FRM, CFP and CIMA UK, alongside its
   

 integrated ArivuPro One degree\-plus\-certification programme. With centers across Karnataka (Bangalore — Koramangala, Malleshwaram) and Tamil Nadu (Chennai — Tambaram, Nungambakkam; and Coimbatore), over 100,000 students trained, 5,000\+ daily learners and 25\+ institutional partnerships (including RV University and GSSS Institute of Engineering and Technology for Women), ArivuPro operates at a B2B/institutional scale — and is now expanding into new certification tracks including US CPA. That growth has outpaced ad hoc HR support.
   

  

 We're hiring a Head of HR Operations \& Recruitment to build
   

 the function properly — owning everything from faculty and staff hiring to onboarding, policy, compliance and people operations across all five centres.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

 This is a build\-and\-own mandate, not a maintenance role. You will design ArivuPro's HR operations function from the ground up — processes, policies and systems — while personally driving recruitment for a business with two distinct hiring tracks: subject\-matter faculty (CA/CS/CMA/ACCA/CPA and other qualified experts) and corporate/support staff (academic coordinators, business development, operations, admin) across centres in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. You'll report to the Director and Vertical Head, and have real latitude to
   

 shape how the function runs.
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL OWN
   

 •Recruitment strategy \& delivery — Run full\-cycle hiring for both faculty (qualified CA/CS/CMA/ACCA/CPA professionals and subject experts) and corporate roles across Bangalore, Chennai (Thambaram, Nungambakkam) and Coimbatore, including sourcing channels specific to each (professional networks and alumni for faculty; standard job boards and referrals for staff).
   

 •Faculty pipeline — Build a repeatable pipeline for scarce, high\-demand faculty talent ahead of new batch launches and new certification tracks (e.g., the upcoming US CPA rollout), so hiring never becomes the bottleneck on batch scheduling.
   

 •HR operations infrastructure — Stand up onboarding, attendance, leave, performance and offboarding processes across all five centres; select and implement an HRMS/ATS suited to a multi\-location, dual\-workforce (faculty \+ staff) academy.
   

 •Policy \& documentation — Own and maintain HR policy documentation, including compensation and incentive structures for revenue\-facing roles (e.g., business development), employment contracts, and faculty engagement terms; ensure consistency across centres.
   

 •Compliance — Ensure statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH, shops \& establishments, and other applicable labour law) across both states of operation — Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
   

 •Institutional coordination — Work closely with academic operations on faculty deployment and batch scheduling, and support HR aspects of institutional partnership agreements (e.g., staffing commitments tied to
   

 university/college tie\-ups).
   

 •Team building — Recruit and lead a small HR ops/recruitment team as hiring volume grows across centres.
   

 •Culture \& retention — Own engagement and retention initiatives for a workforce split between full\-time staff and part\-time/visiting faculty — a materially different retention problem from a typical corporate team.
   

  

 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
   

 •8\+ years in HR with at least 3 years owning recruitment and HR operations end\-to\-end, ideally with P\&L or function\-building accountability.
   

 •Proven experience recruiting specialist/credentialed talent, not just generalist corporate hiring — ed\-tech, professional training, higher education, EdTech, or a similarly expertise\-driven hiring environment is a strong plus.
   

 •Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH); multi\-state/multilocation HR experience preferred given ArivuPro's five\-centre footprint across Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
   

 •Track record of building HR processes and policy from scratch, not just operating within an existing system.
   

 •Comfortable in a fast\-scaling, founder\-led environment — able to move between strategic policy work and hands\-on interview scheduling in the same week.
   

 •Strong stakeholder management — this role sits close to the Director and Vertical Head and coordinates constantly with academic operations.
   

 •Familiarity with the CA/CS/CMA/ACCA coaching or broader professional\-certification education space is a strong advantage, though not mandatory.
   

  

 WHAT ARIVUPRO OFFERS
   

 •A genuine build mandate — shape the HR function for a scaling, multi\-location institution rather than inherit someone else's system.
   

 •Direct access to and mentorship from the Director and Vertical Head.
   

 •A fast\-growing organization with 25\+ institutional partnerships and an expanding certification portfolio (ACCA, and now US CPA).
   

 •Competitive compensation, benchmarked to experience and scope of ownership.
   

  

 TO APPLY
   

 Send your resume and a short note on the most complex HR function you've built or scaled to hr@arivupro.com
   

  

  

 Benefits
   

  

 Health Insurance

 Kobie's Human Resources function in India is being built from the ground up as a strategic hub that will drive the teammate experience, culture, and operational excellence of our India Tech Hub. As Director, Human Resources, you are joining at a pivotal moment where you will establish the foundation for building a Top Workplace in India, one that mirrors Kobie's award\-winning culture in the US while honoring the unique needs and context of the Indian talent market and regulatory environment.
   

  

 You will report directly to the AVP, Human Resources (US\-based) and will own all people operations, compliance, and talent strategy for the India site. While you will work closely with the India Site Lead to operationalize their vision and priorities, your primary accountability is ensuring the India team experiences world\-class HR practices, clear career pathways, and a culture of belonging. You will partner with the India leadership team to bring forward their talent and organizational health concerns, and you will translate Kobie's US HR strategy into India\-specific initiatives that drive retention, engagement, and employer brand strength.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that requires strategic thinking paired with operational rigor. You will build HR policies and processes from the ground up, navigate Indian labor law and compliance, design competitive compensation and benefits, execute talent acquisition in the India market, and create the teammate experiences that make Kobie a destination employer. You will have one direct report, a Manager, Human Resources, and the opportunity to grow this team as India expands.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
* Lead design and launch of compliant, scalable HR policies, processes, and systems aligned with Kobie's global standards. Oversee implementation and ongoing refinement
* Own the complete teammate experience from recruitment through offboarding, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Kobie's values across onboarding, performance management, development, relations, and engagement
* Establish and drive India's talent strategy and recruitment roadmap in partnership with the India Site Lead and US HR leadership. Design a world\-class candidate experience that drives measurable satisfaction. Build and maintain strong pipeline and make final\-round hiring decisions
* Design and oversee India's compensation and benefits strategy, including market benchmarking, salary bands, incentives, and benefits packages that attract and retain top talent competitively and compliantly
* Build a cohesive organizational culture that instills purpose and belonging. Drive engagement initiatives, win celebrations, and recognition programs aligned with Kobie's core values
* Partner with the India Site Lead to operationalize strategic priorities: employer branding and communications, office operations and teammate programs, culture and organizational health, talent development, and cross\-functional collaboration
* Collaborate with India's leadership team to identify and address organizational health concerns (morale, retention, engagement, conflict). Provide guidance, coaching, and resources to help leaders develop their teams and navigate people challenges
* Establish and maintain HR compliance across all India operations: payroll, benefits, statutory requirements, leave management, and labor relations in adherence with Indian employment law and company policies
* Develop direct reports and build HR team capability. Identify learning and development opportunities, provide feedback and coaching, and foster a growth culture as India expands
* Partner with US HR functions to align India initiatives with global strategy while reflecting local needs. Collaborate on tools and processes implementation. Escalate decisions to the AVP, Human Resources
* Track HR metrics including headcount growth, retention rate, time\-to\-fill, quality of hire, offer acceptance rate, offer\-to\-join conversion rate, engagement survey results, and compliance status. Provide regular updates to US leadership and use data to inform continuous improvement
* Anticipate India site needs as the team grows and organization evolves. Identify gaps in processes, tools, or resources and propose solutions proactively. Demonstrate agility in response to changing business priorities
* Serve as the primary HR voice in US\-India leadership forums, communicating site health, opportunities, and challenges while maintaining global HR alignment


**Required**
**What You Need to Be Successful**
* 10\-12 years of HR experience, with a minimum of 5\-6 years in an HR leadership or senior management role overseeing multiple functions (HR Operations, Talent, Compliance, or equivalent scope)
* Deep expertise in Indian labor law, employment regulations, statutory compliance, and payroll/benefits administration. Demonstrated ability to navigate India's complex and evolving regulatory environment
* Proven track record designing and implementing HR policies, processes, and systems. Experience building HR infrastructure from the ground up in a scaling organization preferred
* Demonstrated expertise in compensation and benefits strategy, including market research, salary benchmarking, benefits design, and total rewards planning
* Strong talent acquisition and talent strategy expertise. Experience sourcing, recruiting, and retaining talent in competitive markets. Familiarity with India's tech and talent landscape a strong plus
* Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills. Ability to influence leaders at multiple levels, manage up effectively, and build cross\-functional alignment. Comfort with frequent check\-ins and asynchronous communication across time zones
* Strong people leadership and coaching skills. Ability to attract, develop, and retain HR talent. Experience building high\-performing teams in early\-stage or rapidly scaling environments
* Forward\-thinking and AI\-savvy. Comfort with emerging HR technologies and AI\-enabled tools. Ability to drive AI\-informed thinking and innovation in people practices


**Strongly Preferred**
* Experience in a startup or scale\-up environment where HR infrastructure was built or significantly expanded. Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities
* Experience with US reporting relationship and global HR alignment. Experience supporting international operations or managing cultural bridges between regions
* Proficiency with ADP and Lever
* Strong spreadsheet and data analysis skills


**About Kobie**
 Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth\-focused culture.
   

  

 As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy\-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award\-winning culture to a new region \- creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
   

  

 We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
   

  

 Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
   

  

 To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well\-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work \- recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work\-life balance.
   

  

 As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
   

  

 Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. description:

**Department:**

**Role Overview**

 **Senior Executive – Human Resources**

 **Recruitment \& Hiring, Onboarding \& Orientation, Employee Engagement, and Personnel Documentation** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, creative and project\-driven environment, and should be able to build strong relationships with employees and managers across functions. This is a hands\-on role requiring strong execution, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Recruitment \& Hiring** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process across various functions and levels.
* Work closely with Business Heads and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and role specifications.
* Prepare and update Job Descriptions in consultation with stakeholders.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, recruitment agencies and other relevant channels.
* Screen profiles, conduct preliminary HR discussions and coordinate interviews with relevant stakeholders.
* Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment process and ensure a positive candidate experience.
* Coordinate offer rollouts, negotiations, documentation and joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular updates on open positions, closures and hiring timelines.



**2\. Onboarding \& Orientation** 



* Own and continuously improve the employee onboarding process from offer acceptance through joining.
* Coordinate pre\-joining documentation, background verification and other joining formalities.
* Ensure all new employees complete the required HR and statutory documentation.
* Conduct HR induction and orientation sessions covering company culture, policies, processes, benefits and employee guidelines.
* Coordinate with IT, Admin, Finance and respective business teams to ensure a smooth joining experience.
* Ensure employee information is accurately updated in HR systems and personnel records.



**3\. Employee Engagement** 



* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives that strengthen employee connect, culture and team spirit.
* Work closely with the internal engagement/HR team to organize celebrations, events, activities and employee connect initiatives.
* Support initiatives around employee recognition, communication and workplace culture.
* Gather employee feedback and identify opportunities to improve employee experience.
* Support employee connect initiatives across different offices and teams.
* Contribute to creating a positive, inclusive and collaborative work environment.



**4\. Personnel Documentation \& HR Administration** 



* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee personnel records and documentation.
* Ensure timely completion of joining, confirmation, transfers, promotions, salary revisions and separation documentation.
* Maintain employee files, contracts, HR letters and other relevant documentation in accordance with company processes.
* Ensure HR data is accurately maintained in the HRMS and other internal trackers.
* Prepare HR reports and employee\-related data as required by management.



**5\.** 
**Exit \& Offboarding** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end employee exit and offboarding process, ensuring a smooth and professional separation experience.
* Coordinate resignation acceptance, notice period, last working day, handover and release formalities.
* Ensure completion of exit documentation, clearance processes and Full \& Final settlement coordination.
* Coordinate with IT, Finance, Admin and respective business teams for timely closure of exit formalities.
* Conduct or coordinate exit interviews and capture relevant feedback and insights.
* Ensure timely issuance of relieving, experience and other separation\-related documents.
* Maintain accurate exit records and trackers and ensure all employee data is updated in the HRMS.



**6\.Employee Lifecycle \& HR Support** 



* Act as a point of contact for employees on HR\-related queries and processes.
* Support managers in addressing day\-to\-day employee\-related matters.
* Coordinate employee confirmation, performance review and other lifecycle processes.
* Support the HR team in implementing HR policies, processes and initiatives.
* Assist with employee separations, exit formalities and Full \& Final processes as required.
* Ensure timely communication of HR\-related updates and policies to employees.



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* **2–4 years of relevant HR experience** 
 , preferably in a fast\-paced, service\-oriented, creative, events, advertising, media or experiential marketing environment.
* Prior experience managing recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement and HR documentation is essential.
* Experience working closely with senior stakeholders and business teams will be an advantage.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Good understanding of recruitment and HR operations.
* Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work within tight timelines.

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

***Associate Manager, HRBP***
**The Role**
 As an Associate Manager, HR Business Partner, you will be the key People Partner for a business/function within the Business Org, owning the people agenda for your span end\-to\-end with 3\-5years of Experience.
   

  

 You will partner closely with the Functional Head and leaders across the business to understand business priorities, identify people opportunities and independently drive people interventions on the ground. This role is highly hands\-on, with a strong focus on execution, while requiring the ability to bring a broader organisational lens to people decisions.
   

  

**You Will**
* Own the People Agenda: Independently drive people priorities and conversations for your span, with partnership from the HRBP Lead and a broader organisation lens.
* Partner with the Business: Develop a strong understanding of the business, its priorities, teams and people challenges, and translate business requirements into relevant people interventions.
* Be the People Pulse on the Ground: Build meaningful relationships across levels through regular employee connects, 1:1 conversations and active engagement with employees and managers. Surface concerns early and proactively act on emerging themes.
* Drive Transformation: Partner with the business through organisational changes, leadership transitions, restructuring, team build\-outs, workforce planning and evolving ways of working.
* Influence through Insight: Use people data to identify trends, hotspots and risks, and translate these insights into clear recommendations and actions for managers and leaders.
* Build, Not Just Run: Identify opportunities to improve people practices within the business and independently drive relevant projects and interventions based on the key themes emerging within your function.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Talent Management: Drive talent initiatives for the function, identify critical and high\-potential talent, and partner with leaders on relevant talent actions and interventions.
* Attrition \& Retention: Analyse attrition trends, identify red areas and proactively flag high\-risk cases. Partner with leaders to build and execute interventions focused on retention of critical and top talent.
* Voice of Razors / eNPS: Own the Voice of Razors survey action planning for your function. Deep dive into results, identify key themes and hotspots, work with leaders to build action plans and track progress.
* Employee Engagement: Drive employee engagement initiatives across your span, including employee connects, townhalls and other interventions that strengthen employee experience, culture and connection with the organisation.
* People Insights \& HR Metrics: Analyse relevant people metrics to identify trends, risks and opportunities across the function. Use data alongside on\-ground employee insights to provide clear recommendations and points of view to managers and leaders.
* Business Unit People Projects: Identify and independently drive people projects based on key themes emerging within the function. These could span talent, engagement, retention, manager effectiveness, org effectiveness, ways of working or other business\-specific priorities.
* HRBP for the Function: Serve as the key People point of contact for the allotted span. Build trusted relationships with employees, managers and leaders and provide an informed people perspective on business and people decisions.
* Stakeholder Management: Partner closely with the Functional Head and relevant managers to identify people opportunities, influence decisions and drive interventions through to successful execution.
* Workforce Planning: Partner with business leaders on workforce planning aligned to business priorities, organisational changes and future capability requirements.
* Employee Cost / AOP: Own AOP management of Employee Cost for the respective span, partnering with business stakeholders to ensure people investments and workforce plans remain aligned to business requirements.
* Change Management: Support the organisation through transformation by assessing people implications, proactively identifying risks and driving effective communication and execution of people interventions.
* Performance \& Manager Enablement: Partner with managers on people\-related priorities including performance conversations, goal setting, employee development, difficult conversations and other manager capability requirements.
* 3Ps – Policy, Process \& Practices: Drive effective adoption and implementation of People policies, processes and practices within the function, while identifying opportunities to simplify, improve and build better ways of working.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of proven HRBP experience, preferably in a fast\-paced, high\-growth or transformation\-oriented environment.
* Experience independently partnering with and supporting 200–400 employees across multiple levels of seniority.
* Strong business acumen: You understand that an HRBP is a business partner first. You are able to understand business priorities and connect people interventions to business outcomes.
* High ownership \& bias for action: You don't wait to be told what to do. You identify opportunities, take initiative and move quickly from problem identification to action.
* Strong stakeholder management \& influencing skills: You are comfortable partnering with senior stakeholders, influencing managers and driving outcomes without relying on formal authority.
* Highly employee\-centric: You build genuine relationships with employees, are approachable and trusted, and are comfortable being deeply on the ground with the teams you support.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change: You thrive in evolving environments, can operate without complete answers and are able to navigate organisational transformation with agility.
* Strong analytical ability: You can analyse people data, identify trends and hotspots, diagnose underlying issues and translate insights into practical recommendations and actions.
* You are comfortable handling sensitive employee situations, difficult conversations, conflict and complex people challenges with sound judgement.
* Strong communication: You have a clear, approachable and adaptable communication style and can effectively communicate with employees, managers and senior leadership.
* Experience across core HR domains including Talent Management, Attrition \& Retention, Employee Engagement, Performance Management, Workforce Planning, Change Management and HR Policies \& Processes.
* Experience in employee cost / workforce AOP management would be valuable.


**What makes this role different?**
 This is an opportunity to own the people agenda for a meaningful business span end\-to\-end. You will work closely with senior leadership, be deeply connected to employees on the ground, and have the autonomy to identify and solve people problems that matter to the business.
   

  

 You will get exposure to workforce planning and employee cost/AOP, while also directly shaping talent, organisational effectiveness, engagement and retention. You will have the opportunity to build and implement people practices and projects in a business that is actively transforming.
   

  

 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

title: Service Delivery Manager - HR Operations, including HCM AMS and Related Non-AMS Services
description:
Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!
   

  

 The Service Delivery Manager (HR Operations, including HCM AMS and related non\-AMS services) is accountable for end\-to\-end service delivery across the HR Operations domain. The scope combines the business operations of employee lifecycle administration with Application Management Services (AMS) for the company HCM landscape and the related services outside AMS that are required to deliver complete, stable, and effective HR Operations outcomes. The role integrates HR process delivery, application support, service\-provider performance, controls, data quality, and continuous improvement through a retained\-outsourced operating model.
   

  

****Your Impact:****
* End\-to\-End Service Ownership: Own end\-to\-end service delivery for the HR Operations domain, including employee lifecycle administration, organizational and personal data transactions, HR case and request fulfilment, employee and manager support, and the enabling HCM services. Ensure the combined HR Operations, HCM AMS, and related non\-AMS service landscape meets agreed quality, availability, timeliness, compliance, control, and employee\-experience expectations. Maintain clear end\-to\-end accountability across retained HR teams, outsourced HR Operations, HCM AMS, related non\-AMS providers, HRIS product owners, and other resolver groups, without assuming ownership of policy design or business data ownership assigned elsewhere.
* HCM AMS and Related Non\-AMS Service Management: Govern HCM AMS delivery, including incidents, service requests, defects, problem management, application monitoring, maintenance, minor enhancements, releases, and operational support within the contracted AMS scope. Govern the related non\-AMS services needed for complete HR Operations delivery, such as integrations, interfaces, identity and access dependencies, reporting support, data services, release coordination, specialist technical support, and services delivered under separate contracts or internal ownership. Ensure effective triage, routing, ownership, handoffs, escalation, and resolution across AMS and non\-AMS boundaries, with no gaps or duplicated accountability between providers and internal teams.
* Vendor \& Contract Management: Manage the operational performance of outsourced HR Operations providers, HCM AMS providers, and relevant non\-AMS service providers. Monitor end\-to\-end service performance against SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, contractual commitments, service scope, and business outcomes, including dependencies that span multiple providers. Lead integrated service reviews, operational governance, escalation forums, and corrective\-action follow\-up across the HR Operations service ecosystem.
* Governance, Risk \& Compliance: Ensure HR Operations services and HCM support activities operate in accordance with applicable controls, data\-privacy requirements, security standards, global policies, and locally defined legal requirements. Coordinate audit evidence, control execution, access reviews, operational risk treatment, data\-privacy requirements, and remediation across retained and outsourced services. Own major service escalations affecting employees, managers, HR teams, payroll or downstream processes, ensuring effective business communication and sustainable resolution.
* Financial \& Budget Responsibility: Review provider invoices, resource consumption, charges, and deliverables against contracted scope and approved demand. Support budget monitoring, forecasting, capacity planning, and demand management across HR Operations, AMS, and related non\-AMS services. Identify opportunities to reduce avoidable demand, eliminate service overlap, optimize sourcing, and improve cost\-to\-serve without weakening service quality or controls.
* Continuous Improvement \& Transformation: Drive standardization, automation, knowledge improvement, shift\-left, self\-service, and simplification across HR processes and their enabling HCM services. Improve employee and manager self\-service adoption while ensuring appropriate assisted\-service channels and support for exceptions. Coordinate operational readiness, service transition, testing support, knowledge transfer, release acceptance, and stabilization for HCM changes that enter AMS or affect related non\-AMS services.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with HRIS product owners, HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Finance, Security, Data Privacy, Enterprise IT, Procurement, and service providers. Coordinate operational readiness for HCM releases, organizational changes, annual HR events, provider transitions, and other changes affecting HR Operations demand, data, integrations, or system stability. Provide integrated service\-performance insights, trend analysis, root\-cause findings, risks, capacity views, and recommendations covering HR Operations and the supporting AMS and non\-AMS landscape.


****Your Experience And Qualification:****
* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, Information Systems, Operations, or a related discipline
* 5\-8 years of relevant HR Operations, HR shared services, HCM application support, AMS, or outsourced service\-delivery experience

title: Learning and Development Manager
description:
**Why This Role Exists** 




  





 As MPC expands across locations and cities, we need a Learning \& Development function that makes frontline performance consistent,
 



 repeatable, and scalable.
 



 This role will build MPC's L\&D function from 0 to 1: creating a system where every new hire becomes floor\-ready quickly, every store
 



 operates to the same standard, and high\-performing frontline employees have a clear path to leadership.
 



 This is a hands\-on role that works closely with Operations to translate SOPs into practical training and continuously improve
 



 standards using frontline insights.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Build \& Own the L\&D Function
 



 • Design and establish MPC's Learning \& Development function end\-to\-end
 



 • Develop the L\&D strategy, training calendar, documentation, and standardized systems aligned with expansion plans
 



 • Create training standards that can be consistently implemented across locations
 



 2\. Frontline Training \& Module Development
 



 • Build role\-specific modules for kitchen, counter/service, delivery packing, hygiene, food safety, and operational SOPs
 



 • Develop practical training content, assessments, checklists, and on\-floor evaluations
 



 • Continuously update modules based on operational requirements and feedback
 



 3\. New Store \& New Hire Training
 



 • Build standardized new\-hire onboarding that gets employees floor\-ready within defined timelines
 



 • Create a new\-store training program to ensure teams are ready before launch
 



 • Work with Operations and HR to plan manpower and training requirements ahead of openings
 



 4\. Train\-the\-Trainer Program
 



 • Build a train\-the\-trainer framework across MPC outlets
 



 • Identify and develop Store Managers and high\-performing employees as internal trainers
 



 • Equip trainers with guides, assessments, and coaching tools so stores can independently train as MPC scales
 



 5\. Career Growth \& Internal Talent Development
 



 • Build a clear frontline career path such as Crew → Shift Lead → Store Manager
 



 • Define competencies and development requirements for progression across levels
 



 • Identify high\-potential employees and build an internal pipeline for store leadership
 



 6\. Training Effectiveness \& Quality Measurement
 



 • Establish measurable training\-readiness metrics, audits, skill assessments, and certification processes
 



 • Track training completion, assessment scores, operational performance, and recurring gaps
 



 • Use store audits, practical checks, and frontline feedback to continuously improve training
 



 7\. SOP \& Operations Partnership
 



 • Partner closely with the GM – Operations to convert new and revised SOPs into structured training
 



 • Ensure operational changes are communicated and embedded through training
 



 • Use recurring training gaps and frontline feedback to improve SOPs and execution
 



 8\. L\&D Systems \& Scalability
 



 • Evaluate and implement suitable LMS, digital learning, and assessment tools where required
 



 • Build systems that scale across locations without requiring a dedicated trainer at every outlet
 



 • Maintain a centralized repository of training modules, SOPs, assessments, and certification records
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  





 Must\-Have Skills
 



 • 7\+ years of overall experience with significant experience in Learning \& Development
 



 • Senior L\&D/training experience within an organized, multi\-location F\&B/QSR business
 



 • Strong experience designing training modules, not only delivering pre\-existing content
 



 • Proven experience training frontline teams across multiple outlets and supporting new\-store openings
 



 • Experience building train\-the\-trainer and frontline career\-progression frameworks
 



 • Strong understanding of outlet operations and frontline employee challenges
 



 • Hands\-on, analytical, and comfortable spending significant time at outlets while working closely with Operations
 



 Good to Have
 



 • Experience with an LMS or digital learning platform
 



 • Instructional design or digital training\-content experience
 



 • Experience building scalable training systems during rapid expansion
 



  





**Reporting Structure** 




  





 Reports to: Founder (Jash Arora)
 



 Works closely with: GM – Operations, HR, Store \& Area Managers, and functional teams
 



 Owns: Frontline training systems, new\-hire and new\-store training, train\-the\-trainer, career development, and training effectiveness
 



  





**Why MUMBAI PAV CO.** 




  





 • Build the L\&D function from 0 to 1 with real ownership over how frontline capability is developed
 



 • Multi\-city expansion underway — create training systems that can scale across new stores and markets
 



 • Work closely with Operations and leadership to directly influence store standards and people development
 



 • Build an internal leadership pipeline and shape career growth for frontline teams
